Package org.cibseven.bpm.engine.rest.util

Class InitialSetupUtil

java.lang.Object
org.cibseven.bpm.engine.rest.util.InitialSetupUtil
public class InitialSetupUtil extends Object
Decides whether the first-run setup may create an administrator without authentication.

The setup is meant for an engine nobody has configured yet. Whether an administrator exists cannot be told reliably (CVE-2026-77226): administrators can be configured with adminUsers and adminGroups or be granted authorizations, so the camunda-admin group may be empty, or missing, on an engine that is fully administered. The setup is therefore only available while the engine's identity service is writable, it holds no users, groups or authorizations, and no administrators are configured.

An engine whose users and groups are kept elsewhere (single sign-on or LDAP in the webclient), which grants no authorizations and configures no administrators, looks like a fresh one. Such an installation must configure its administrators.
